reviews.x: I have three different stampers from three different manufacturers.  This one is my new favorite!  It works flawlessly.  It is heavy and sturdy, which allows for excellent precision when applying your stamps to your nail.  My stamps come out perfectly, every time.  No priming necessary!  It works right out the box.  Plus, it came with an extra stamp head and an extra scraper.  BUY IT, you won't be disappointed!!!

This is my new "go to" stamper.  Easy to hold and use.  The Stamper Head did not seem to require 'prepping'.  However, I did washed it in a little dish soap wiped with alcohol and finished with a lint roller.  Stamper Head is soft but not too squishy so images are not overly distorted. A light touch picks up images and stamps on nails.  The Stamper Holder allows it to stand upright so it is not rolling around,  The Stamper Head is about the same size as the usual 'XL' Stamper.  Delivery

I just started building my manicure collection and added this item as well as stamping plates to it. I like the look and feel of this stamper and it's pretty easy to use once you know what you're doing. Practice makes perfect though! I'm still learning but I'm sure the more I practice the better and faster I'll get. It took me a long while my first time but my nails came out looking nice and I got lots of compliments.

I love this thing!  I wish they made a bigger one so I could use it when my nails get long.  It's easy to hold, it uses regular size (28mm) replacement heads.  I actually prefer the stamping heads I get from Messy Mansion, but they work perfectly in this holder.  It's well made, solid, and I like that it has the flat side on the "crystal" so it can stand upright.  This is my favorite regular size stamper, and if they made it so it holds the bigger stamping heads, it would be my favorite.

This stamper is wonderful! It really grabs a hold of the nail polish. One thing to keep in mind is that it may need primed by taking a nail file to it and lightly buffing it before using for the first time.  When applying the stamp to the nail you don't have to roll this stamper since it is soft. Instead just press it directly down on top of the nail. Also don't use nail polish remover on your nail stamper, instead use tape to remove the excess nail polish  from the stamper. 5+ stars!

reviews.t: My first set of nail art stamp supplies that I ...
reviews.x: My first set of nail art stamp supplies that I have tried, and it took a bit to get used to and get a hang of, but the stamper and scraper seem to work well and as intended. As I can never seem to get the picture on straight or centered, I would probably look into getting the clear stamper to see if that would help.

When I received my product the package was not damaged, but the Pink stamper head was stuck on the plastic container that it came in was terrible, I had to cut it to get it out then it was no good so I had to throw it away &the white head , took me a lot of hours to get it into the stamper, fortunely I finally got it to stay in stamper & does really good stamping.  Have not used the scrapers.  I don't recommend to anyone.

This is my first ever stamp and I decided to try it out. I've researched a lot of different stamps and this one has none of the problems that many have. It picks up the image well after using a buffer on it gently. It's squishy enough that you don't have to roll it on your finger and transfers nicely. It takes a bit of practice but I already want to do my nails like, everyday now.
I just started a nail art side business and I needed to stock my supplies.  I'm still learning all of the tricks of nail art stamping, but this is an amazing set.  And its absolutely beautiful!!!

reviews.t: Excellent stamper! Doesn't feel cheap and is super cute
reviews.x: Excellent stamper! Doesn't feel cheap and is super cute! I used it right out of the package and picked everything up beautifully!

Great stamper the tacky stuff they use to keep stamper in package be careful when taking it out cause it tears easily but they replaced and didn't make me return the other one, they were very helpful and quick to responding to my problem I recommend this seller and this item. This stamper picks up and applies images so nicely it actually worked on plates that weren't etched well so I do recommend I did wash the stamper with warm water and dish soap and I lightly wiped acetone once over the other

reviews.t: takes a lot of priming to get it to work
reviews.x: I had issues at first with the stamper. I could not get the polish to stick. I tried priming it but it still wouldn't pick up the polish. So I kept filing it more and more and finally it started working. I'm a little disappointed with it bc this was supposed to be a quality stamper but I've had better luck with cheaper ones. I gave it 4 stars bc it did eventually start working but it was very frustrating.

SUPER cute and really simple to use, came with a replacement insert and is really easy to change. It's also really interesting to touch as well. The scrapers are pretty sturdy, kind of like a credit card and feel like they should last a while.
I love it. Jus as the picture. Had no idea it was coming with 2 extra scraping cards which I love and an extra gummy stamp. Only sad part was it came apart but nothing glue can't fix
I really like the stamper. I get lots of comments on it. However, I was expecting the scrapers to be plastic but they're cardboard. Very low quality.
The scrappers are just cardboard that doesn't work very well at all. The stamper is pretty but small. It works well though.
Great product exactly as described. I will make further purchases with this seller. They were also  ontime.
Didn't hold any polish on the stamper so would not leave a design, tried different polishes and nothing!!:(
The quality is good, but without lid to protect it, it already broke. And I hope it have bigger size
I'm sure this will be great once I discover how to use it correctly.  Did need to be primed.
Love this stamper! It grabs the polish perfectly and big enough to cover your entire nail!
The stamper is small & adhered to the product packing rendering it unusable.
Never worked for me won't pick up anything from the stamp plate

There is no image that picks up. Watched YouTube videos and primed both ends after getting no image and there is still absolutely nothing. I made sure to buy the same brand stamper and plates thinking I was going to have great results... what a headache and mess! Don't waste your money on this! Now I'm left with $35 worth of stamping materials that I can't do anything with and I don't even want to waste more time trying to return everything.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the stamper as easy to hold and use, working well for both beginners and experienced users.
Many reviewers note the stamper is sturdy, well made, and doesn't feel cheap.
Several reviewers mention needing to prime or buff the stamper head before it picks up polish well, with some finding it required extensive filing.
Some reviewers report packaging issues, including the stamper head sticking to packaging or the stamper coming apart.
Reviewers appreciate the included extras such as replacement heads and scraping cards.
